correctness.rationale: The four-simplex Δ^4 has 31 nonempty Hasse nodes and 75 primitive cover edges. For g in S5 an invariant matching is exactly a union of primitive-edge orbits. For o selected orbits the signed augmented reduced trace contribution is (-1)^(o-1), including -1 for the empty union, giving chi_E(g)=-P_g(-1). A legal face has no repeated Hasse nodes and no directed closed Forman V-path. I independently implemented an exhaustive C++ DFS over all orbit subsets with exact incidence, overlap and directed-cycle pruning. Its six nonidentity class counts, including empty, were 449440,10480,1029,1,32,3, and signed reduced Lefschetz traces -16,0,-1,-1,0,1 in the stated cycle-type order. Scoville §5.2 provides the exact full f-vector and identity reduced Euler characteristic 212456. S5 character arithmetic gives seven integral virtual Specht coefficients 1769,7079,8851,10623,8854,7084,1772 and 1769 full quotient reduced Euler characteristic. These are *virtual alternating* homology coefficients, not actual degreewise Betti numbers; the unknown graded homology is not inferred.
